character: Highest Méribel village at 1,750m. Ski-in/ski-out — truly at the foot of the slopes. Built 1972, modern residences. Snow-sure. Heart of Les 3 Vallées. Best placed for 600km access. Snowpark of European renown. Pas du Lac cable car to Vanoise National Park. Family-friendly with ski schools at village base.
dining: Mountain restaurants, local bars, piste-side dining. Tourist office area restaurants.
shopping: Mini-markets, bakery, newsagent, sports rental and retail shops, wellness activities. All within easy reach.
apres_scene: Relaxed village apres. Bars and restaurants in the Châtelet/Laitelet areas.
activities_nearby: Snowpark (European renown). Pas du Lac cable car to Vanoise. Via ferrata (highest in Europe). Cross-country skiing. Hiking. Snowshoeing. Free shuttle to Méribel Centre (10 min) for Parc Olympique. Cinema.
